scope: Read-only arithmetic checks of retained profiles and declared final totals; not agricultural validation or new experimental observations.

source.method: Original compare_impacts uses Fraction(str(value)), strict < -tau and > tau; both boundaries inclusive within tolerance.

limits: Tolerance classifies A minus B within each impact; it is not an acceptable estimation-error bound.
No uncertainty, significance or agronomic adequacy is inferred.
Browser geometry and rounded labels do not determine classifications.
An unavailable or unscheduled answer is never replaced by zero.
